description: One Markdown document for many videos (the pack format): a header per video with title, channel, URL and chapters, then each transcript in timestamped paragraphs. Set maxTokens to fit a budget: the pack trims transcripts to fit and says what it left out. Cost: about 12k tokens per hour of video unless maxTokens caps it. Prefer get_outline, get_section and search_transcript when you only need parts.

collection.description: Export this saved collection (id or name)

limit.description: Most videos taken from each playlist, channel or feed. Default: 50

maxTokens.description: Token budget for the whole pack

urls.description: Video, playlist, channel or feed URLs (lists are expanded into their videos)

name: export_context_pack
title: Export a context pack
